rule.explanationUz:
Bu betda UCHINCHI olmosh turi qo'shiladi — EGALIK OLMOSHI.

  EGALIK SIFATI    EGALIK OLMOSHI
  (ot BILAN)       (ot SIZ, yolg'iz)
  ─────────────────────────────────
  my               mine
  your             yours
  his              his
  her              hers
  its              — (ishlatilmaydi)
  our              ours
  your             yours
  their            theirs

MISOL:
  This is MY house.  →  It's MINE.
  This is HER house. →  It's HERS.

Ya'ni: otni takrorlamaslik uchun egalik olmoshi ishlatiladi.
O'zbekchada: 'mening uyim' → 'meniki'.

rules.enRule: Possessive adjectives come before a noun.
Possessive pronouns don't take a noun after them.

rule.warningUz:
KITOBDAGI OGOHLANTIRISH:
  ✅ It's my dog.   (sifat + ot)
  ✅ It's mine.     (olmosh, otsiz)
  ❌ It's mine book.  ← BU XATO!

Ikkalasini birga ishlatib bo'lmaydi.

Va APOSTROF hech qachon qo'yilmaydi:
  ✅ yours, hers, ours, theirs, its
  ❌ your's, her's, our's, their's, it's
rule.noteUz:
'HIS' yagona so'z — u ikkala vazifada ham bir xil:
  This is HIS car.  (sifat)
  The car is HIS.   (olmosh)

'ITS' uchun egalik olmoshi YO'Q. Narsa haqida
'It's its' deb aytilmaydi — buning o'rniga boshqa yo'l topiladi.
rule.extraUz:
QAYERDA ISHLATILADI:
  1) Savolga javobda:
     Whose bag is this? — It's mine. / It's hers.
  2) Taqqoslashda:
     My car is red, yours is blue.
  3) 'of' bilan:
     a friend of mine — mening bir do'stim

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in ours, yours, or hers.
exercises.instructionUz: ours, yours yoki hers — jadvaldagi bo'sh joylarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI SXEMA:
  This is MY / YOUR / HIS / HER / ITS / OUR / YOUR / THEIR house.
  It's   MINE / ___ / HIS / ___ / — / ___ / ___ / THEIRS.

Berilganlari: mine, his, theirs.
To'ldirish kerak: yours, hers, ours, yours.
('its' uchun egalik olmoshi yo'q — shuning uchun chiziqcha.)

exercises.instructionEn: Match the people to the objects. Then, in pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Odamlarni buyumlarga moslang. So'ng juftlikda namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
ODAMLAR:
  Peter — kostyumdagi ishbilarmon, chamadon va portfel bilan
  Lyn   — shlyapa va ko'zoynakdagi ayol, plyaj kiyimida
  Sam   — chelakli va suzish ko'zoynagidagi kichkina bola
  Tom   — velosiped dubulg'asidagi erkak

BUYUMLAR: bicycle, passport, ball, bag

MOSLASH MANTIG'I:
  ishbilarmon sayohat qiladi → pasport
  plyajga ketayotgan ayol    → sumka
  plyajdagi bola             → to'p
  dubulg'adagi erkak         → velosiped

NAMUNA:
  SA: Whose bag is this?
  SB: I think it's Lyn's. Yes, it's hers.

Javobda IKKI shakl ketma-ket ishlatiladi:
  Lyn'S  — egalik shakli (ism bilan)
  HERS   — egalik olmoshi (ismsiz)

'I think' — 'menimcha' — taxminni yumshatadi.

items.question: Whose bag is this?
items.answer: I think it's Lyn's. Yes, it's hers.

items.question: Whose passport is this?
items.answer: I think it's Peter's. Yes, it's his.
items.whyUz: Piter — chamadonli ishbilarmon, sayohat qiladi. Erkak → his.

items.question: Whose ball is this?
items.answer: I think it's Sam's. Yes, it's his.

items.question: Whose bicycle is this?
items.answer: I think it's Tom's. Yes, it's his.

exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir gapda IKKI tanlov bor — ikkalasini ham to'g'ri qiling.

QAROR QOIDASI:
  • Keyin OT kelsami? → egalik SIFATI (my, your, his, her, our, their)
  • Ot YO'QMI?        → egalik OLMOSHI (mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs)
  • Savol odam haqidami? → Who's
  • Savol egasi haqidami (keyin ot kelsa)? → Whose

items.whyUz: Kitobda tagiga chizilgan namuna. Javob 'She's my sister' — odamning kimligi.
Keyin OT ('sister') keladi → egalik SIFATI 'my'. 'mine sister' XATO.
Gap oxirida ot YO'Q → egalik OLMOSHI 'yours'.
Keyin OT ('dog') keladi va egasi so'ralyapti → Whose.

items.uz: U kim? — Tom va Juliyaning otasi
items.whyUz: Bitta ota, ikki farzand → 's faqat OXIRGI ismga. Ikkalasiga qo'ysangiz, ikkita alohida ota degani bo'ladi.

rule.titleUz: Present Simple — shakli, imlosi va qo'llanishi
rule.explanationUz:
Present Simple — ingliz tilining ENG KO'P ishlatiladigan zamoni.

SHAKLI juda sodda: fe'l o'zgarmaydi, FAQAT he/she/it bilan -s oladi.

  TASDIQ            INKOR
  I live            I don't live
  you live          you don't live
  he/she/it liveS   he/she/it DOESN'T live
  we live           we don't live
  you live          you don't live
  they live         they don't live

DIQQAT — INKORDA -s TUSHADI:
  ✅ He doesn't live.
  ❌ He doesn't lives.
'-s' allaqachon 'doesn't' ichida bor (does + not).

keyRules.enRule: Most verbs take -s in the affirmative third person singular.

keyRules.uzRule: 3-shaxs birlik INKORDA doesn't + fe'lning asos shakli.
keyRules.enRule: We use doesn't + the base form of the verb to form the negative third person singular.
In all other persons we use don't.

rule.warningUz:
IMLO QOIDALARI (kitobdagi Spelling):

  1) -ss, -sh, -ch, -x, -o bilan tugagan fe'llar → -ES
     I finish → he finishES
     I wash   → he washES
     I go     → he goES
     I watch  → he watchES
     I fix    → he fixES

  2) UNDOSH + y bilan tugasa → -y tushadi, -IES qo'shiladi
     I study → he studIES
     I fly   → he flIES
     I try   → he trIES

  3) LEKIN unli + y bo'lsa → oddiy -s
     I play  → he playS
     I enjoy → he enjoyS
     I buy   → he buyS

  Farqni ko'ring: studY (d + y = undosh+y) → studies
                  plaY  (a + y = unli+y)   → plays
rule.noteUz:
QO'LLANISHI (kitobdagi Use):

Present Simple UCH holatda ishlatiladi:

  1) DOIMIY holat (permanent state):
     He lives in Madrid.  — U Madridda yashaydi.
     She is a teacher.    — U o'qituvchi.

  2) TAKRORLANUVCHI harakat (repeated action):
     She goes to the cinema on Saturdays.

  3) KUNDALIK tartib (daily routine):
     I get up at seven o'clock.

HOZIR sodir bo'layotgan ish uchun ISHLATILMAYDI —
uning uchun boshqa zamon bor (Present Continuous).
rule.extraUz:
TALAFFUZ — -s uchta xil o'qiladi (Unit 3 ko'plik qoidasi bilan bir xil):
  /s/  — jarangsizdan keyin: works, likes, sits
  /z/  — jaranglidan keyin:  lives, goes, plays
  /ɪz/ — s, sh, ch, ge dan keyin: washes, finishes, watches

exercises.instructionEn: Study the table, then complete the rules.
exercises.explanationUz: Kitobdagi to'ldirilishi kerak bo'lgan ikkita qoida.

items.textEn: Most verbs take ____ in the affirmative third person singular. (I live - he lives)
items.uz: 3-shaxs birlik tasdiq gapda fe'lga nima qo'shiladi?
items.whyUz: he/she/it bilan fe'l -s oladi: he liveS, he workS.

items.textEn: We use doesn't ... In all other persons we use ____ . (he doesn't live - I don't live)
items.uz: Qolgan shaxslarda inkor uchun nima ishlatiladi?
items.whyUz: I/you/we/they bilan DON'T. Faqat he/she/it bilan DOESN'T.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the Present Simple table for the verb 'live'.
exercises.instructionUz: 'live' fe'li uchun Present Simple jadvalini to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz: Butun jadvalni yozib chiqish — shaklni mahkam o'rnashtiradi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct form of the verb.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir fe'l uchun IMLO qoidasini tanlang:

  oddiy -s     — ko'pchilik fe'llar
  -es          — -ss, -sh, -ch, -x, -o bilan tugasa
  -ies         — UNDOSH + y bilan tugasa (y tushadi)
  oddiy -s     — UNLI + y bilan tugasa (y qoladi)

items.whyUz: UNLI (o) + y → y QOLADI, oddiy -s. 'enjoies' XATO.

exercises.explanationUz: Uchala qoidani ham aralash mashq qilamiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the present simple verb forms in the text in Ex. 4.
exercises.instructionUz: 4-mashqdagi matnda (Tonining xati, 26-bet) Present Simple fe'l shakllarini toping.
exercises.explanationUz:
Tonining xati BUTUNLAY Present Simple da yozilgan —
chunki u DOIMIY holatlar va KUNDALIK tartib haqida.

Har bir fe'lni topganda ikki narsaga qarang:
  1) egasi kim? (I / he / she / we)
  2) -s bormi yoki yo'qmi?

Qoidani tekshiring: -s faqat he/she/it bilan bo'lishi kerak.

items.whyUz: 'I'm Tony Philips' — 'I am' ning qisqasi. 'to be' fe'li.

items.textEn: There ____ seven of us in our family. (be)

items.whyUz: 'you' bilan savol → Do. 'Does' faqat he/she/it bilan.

items.textEn: I also ____ going to the cinema. (like)
I ____ to the cinema every Saturday. (go)
items.whyUz: 'I' bilan -s yo'q. Takrorlanuvchi harakat — Present Simple.

items.textEn: I ____ like going to the theatre. (not like)
items.whyUz: 'I' bilan inkor → don't. To'liq: I don't like.

wordFormation.introUz: 29-bet — egalik olmoshlari va Present Simple imlosi.

groups.explanationUz: Ko'pchiligiga -s qo'shiladi, lekin apostrof HECH QACHON qo'yilmaydi.
Bu tovushlardan keyin -s eshitilmaydi, shuning uchun -es qo'shiladi va yangi bo'g'in paydo bo'ladi.
'y' dan OLDIN undosh bo'lsa, 'y' tushadi va -ies qo'shiladi. Unli bo'lsa — 'y' qoladi.
do/does + not qisqaradi. Inkorda fe'l ASOS shaklida qoladi.

patterns.formula: This is + EGALIK SIFATI + ot. → It's + EGALIK OLMOSHI.
patterns.exampleEn: This is my house. → It's mine.
patterns.explanationUz: Otni takrorlamaslik uchun egalik olmoshi ishlatiladi.

patterns.formula: Whose + ot + is this? — I think it's ISM's. Yes, it's his/hers.
patterns.exampleEn: Whose bag is this? — I think it's Lyn's. Yes, it's hers.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu sumka kimning? — Menimcha, Linniki. Ha, u uniki.
patterns.explanationUz: 'I think' — taxminni yumshatadi. Javobda avval ism + 's, keyin olmosh.

patterns.exampleEn: He works at the local hospital. She goes to the cinema on Saturdays.
patterns.exampleUz: U mahalliy kasalxonada ishlaydi. U shanba kunlari kinoga boradi.
patterns.explanationUz: Faqat 3-shaxs birlikda -s. Boshqa shaxslarda fe'l o'zgarmaydi.
Inkorda -s TUSHADI: doesn't LIVE (doesn't lives EMAS).

patterns.exampleEn: I don't like going to the theatre.

patterns.formula: Present Simple — doimiy holat va takrorlanuvchi harakat.
patterns.exampleEn: He lives in Madrid. She goes to the cinema on Saturdays.
patterns.exampleUz: U Madridda yashaydi. U shanba kunlari kinoga boradi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Hozir sodir bo'layotgan ish uchun ISHLATILMAYDI —
faqat doimiy holat, odat va kundalik tartib uchun.
